details: This package is a security-test canary that beacons host metadata. Its file backend-canary.js hashes the machine's hostname (/etc/hostname) and the current OS username with SHA-256 and sends them as query parameters in a single HTTPS GET to hxxps://webhook[.]site/314c4c8c-4eba-4012-9bf5-0a45805cd355/npm-backend-574b7ccdaeb61dd9dd70d6d4/lifecycle?host=…&user=…. The package self-identifies as a controlled ingestion test ("controlled npm backend ingestion gnu_longname", marker file marker.txt, and a deliberately over-long filename), ships no lifecycle hooks, and index.js only exports a static string. No credentials, tokens, environment values, files or wallet data are collected or transmitted — only hashed hostname and username.
